_about: One entry per column of your table: the column name, then the sentence the model reads to fill it. Keep 'or not stated'. Change these to what you read for every week.
study site: The study site location, or 'not stated'.
soil depth sampled: The soil depth sampled with units, or 'not stated'.
years of the experiment: The years or duration of the experiment, or 'not stated'.
main result: The main result with numbers, or 'not stated'.
